svg.title: Ladder example – seal-in + star-delta
svg.text: 3 · Ladder diagram – pump start with seal-in and star-delta (networks 4 to 7)
Tag name above each element, address below: Delta / Siemens. Contacts in series = AND, parallel branch = OR. Power flows from the left rail to the right.
seal-in: M_RUN holds itself after START is released.
S_STOP is an NC button: input = 1 when not pressed → NO contact.
Network 5 – main contactor + star timer T_YD 5 s
Network 7 – 0.1 s after the star contactor opened → delta
Siemens LAD: the same rungs; TON in the instance DB "DB_T_YD",
contact on "DB_T_YD".Q. Delta: TMR T0 K50 = 50 × 100 ms.
Rule: one coil per tag (no double coil).
The last rung written in the scan wins – a second OUT Y0.2
lower down would silently overwrite this one.
networks 4–7 of program 1 in LAD, Delta + Siemens addresses
Guide 37 · page 3 · EXAMPLE – check with your PLC configuration
